import { CancelledError } from './errors.js';
import { delayFor } from './backoff.js';
import { deferred } from './deferred.js';
import { normalizeJobOptions, normalizeOptions } from './options.js';
import { PriorityQueue } from './pqueue.js';

export class Scheduler {
  #opts;
  #queue = new PriorityQueue();
  #running = new Set();
  #waiting = new Set();
  #keyHolders = new Map();
  #seq = 0;
  #idleWaiters = [];

  constructor(opts) {
    this.#opts = normalizeOptions(opts);
  }

  schedule(fn, options) {
    const opts = normalizeJobOptions(options);
    const d = deferred();
    if (opts.signal && opts.signal.aborted) {
      d.reject(new CancelledError());
      return d.promise;
    }
    const entry = {
      fn,
      key: opts.key,
      priority: opts.priority,
      retries: opts.retries,
      backoff: opts.backoff,
      shouldRetry: opts.shouldRetry,
      signal: opts.signal,
      attempt: 1,
      seq: ++this.#seq,
      deferred: d,
      state: 'queued',
      timer: null,
      aborted: false,
      settled: false,
    };
    if (opts.signal && typeof opts.signal.addEventListener === 'function') {
      opts.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => this.#onAbort(entry), { once: true });
    }
    this.#queue.push(entry, entry.priority, entry.seq);
    this.#pump();
    return d.promise;
  }

  idle() {
    if (this.#queue.size === 0 && this.#running.size === 0 && this.#waiting.size === 0) {
      return Promise.resolve();
    }
    return new Promise((resolve) => this.#idleWaiters.push(resolve));
  }

  stats() {
    return { queued: this.#queue.size, running: this.#running.size, waiting: this.#waiting.size };
  }

  #pump() {
    for (;;) {
      if (this.#running.size >= this.#opts.concurrency) break;
      const entry = this.#queue.takeFirst((e) =>
        e.key === undefined || !this.#keyHolders.has(e.key) || this.#keyHolders.get(e.key) === e,
      );
      if (!entry) break;
      this.#start(entry);
    }
  }

  #start(entry) {
    entry.state = 'running';
    this.#running.add(entry);
    if (entry.key !== undefined) this.#keyHolders.set(entry.key, entry);
    this.#runAttempt(entry);
  }
